title: PR review/merge automation w/ separate agent + permission gate
objective: ADR-0001 §5: `hf review request <pr#>` enqueues weave review (WL-020) + permission ask (WL-021) to a separate reviewer session; reviewer runs /code-review and records approve/deny. `hf merge <pr#>` merges only on approved+permission-granted (gh pr merge --squash), ff develop; deny re-opens task for a fix cycle; pending waits (retryable).
acceptance_criteria: PR review/merge automation w/ separate agent + permission gate: implemented + cargo test green + checkpointed
